notes.title: Sneak Peek: Stage 2 Update!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

As you all know, we’re not just releasing new Stages – the full game will also feature enhanced visuals and puzzles for Stages 1, 2, and 3. 

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/f615e2cc7391e174367551614e6be973c4d676cd.png
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/72fde28c03ea01d41accf5f4bb1a8c89f6a00730.png
In this updated Stage 2 puzzle, the Boy and El must flip boxes while avoiding the White Horseman and its hunting dog. 

Let us know what you think! 

- The Acts29Games team

notes.title: Hotfix bug fixes
notes.notes:
There was a bug in Stage 2 where the fanatic could teleport, which has been fixed.

We apologize for disturbing your enjoyment.

notes.title: Diaspora bug fixes and camera direction and animation updates
notes.notes:
hello.

We bring you updates from Diaspora.


Colorful camera production

- We added a variety of camera directions to maximize the situation.

Add animation

- Added the main character boy's death motion.
- The unnatural turn movement of ‘L’ has been added.

Some bug fixes

- Fix some bugs
- Fixed the phenomenon of jumping in place when hanging from a rope.
- Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when the settings menu was selected during the game.



We will work hard for everyone who enjoys Diaspora.
We are waiting for your feedback!

thank you

Acts29games

notes.title: Four Diaspora Countries Language Support and Game Update
notes.notes:
Hello.

I'm sending you an update of the diaspora.


 Support for additional 4 languages 

- Spanish, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), and Chinese (Traditional) Support for a total of four languages


Support settings while playing games

- You can now change the settings during the game.


 Improve interaction delay 

- Modify to move smoothly by reducing the area where the delay was after interaction


I will work hard for those who enjoy the diaspora.
I'm waiting for your feedback!

Thank you.

Acts29games
